newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: APEC to admit Vietnam and Peru by 1998.
newsitem.headline: APEC to admit Vietnam and Peru by 1998.

text.p: APEC leaders have agreed to admit Vietnam and Peru as new members of the trade grouping by 1998, earlier than previously expected, Malaysian Prime Minister Mahathir Mohamad said on Monday.

"Everyone is agreed that Vietnam and Peru should be admitted as soon as possible," Mahathir told a news conference after leaders of the 18-member Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation forum ended their one-day summit at this former U.S. naval base.

APEC trade and foreign ministers had recommended after talks at the weekend that the group wait until 1999 to admit any new members and said it should develop criteria for new membership by the next annual meeting in Vancouver.
APEC's three-year moratorium on new members expired this year.

But Mahathir said the leaders, during the discussions on Monday, decided against coming out with a detailed set of membership criteria and opted to move up the timetable for admitting new members, with Vietnam and Peru first in line.
"The problem is once you set criteria, and everybody meets the criteria, then they are automatically admitted," he said.
The move follows pressure from Southeast Asian nations to admit Vietnam, the only member of the Association of Southeast Asian Nations (ASEAN) to remain outside APEC.
Mahathir said the leaders wanted "to keep a cosy membership" by limiting membership in an informal way.
"If APEC is to be effective the membership should not be too large as to be unwieldy," Mahathir said.
He said the decision was not included in the summit declaration "because no firm decision was made other than to shorten the period" for the first new entrants from three years to two.
The decision to admit Vietnam and Peru will be formally announced at Vancouver and they will join the group at the 1998 APEC summit in Kuala Lumpur.
Mahathir declined to spell out why Peru was acceptable as a new member and not its South American neighbour Ecuador, which has also applied for membership.
At least 11 countries have applied to become APEC members.
